subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: What WhatsApp reaction-read contract should OpenClaw support: passive plugin events only, agent-visible session events, or a persisted generic reactions query with historical retention?
rationale: Each option changes privacy, routing, storage, retention, and whether reactions can influence agent behavior; source inspection cannot determine the intended product contract.

options.title: Stage events, then queries
options.body: First add authorized passive add/remove events through the owning WhatsApp plugin, then add SQLite-backed generic listing only after retention and completeness semantics are defined.

options.title: Passive hooks only
options.body: Implement the narrower contract tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79996 without promising historical retrieval or agent-session delivery.

options.title: Full persisted history
options.body: Design and implement events, canonical SQLite persistence, generic listing, retention controls, and upgrade behavior as one broader feature program.

recommendation.title: Stage events, then queries
recommendation.body: First add authorized passive add/remove events through the owning WhatsApp plugin, then add SQLite-backed generic listing only after retention and completeness semantics are defined.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the broadest recent history across the WhatsApp channel, inbound lifecycle, and approval-reaction boundary where the product choice would land.
